task: In the Hugging Face documentation, find the tutorial on loading adapters with PEFT, tell me how to load in 8bit or 4bit.
answer: Per the Hugging Face PEFT documentation (Quantization developer guide, https://huggingface.co/docs/peft/en/developer_guides/quantization), load a model in 8bit or 4bit with the bitsandbytes integration: create a BitsAndBytesConfig from transformers and pass it as quantization_config to from_pretrained. 4-bit: config = BitsAndBytesConfig(load_in_4bit=True, bnb_4bit_quant_type="nf4", bnb_4bit_use_double_quant=True, bnb_4bit_compute_dtype=torch.bfloat16); model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1", quantization_config=config). 8-bit: set load_in_8bit=True instead. Then call model = prepare_model_for_kbit_training(model) from peft to prepare the quantized model before applying a PEFT adapter (e.g., LoRA).
